notes.title: Update 1.2.5
notes.content:
Added Stat Distribution System. Now you gain points after each level that can be used and distributed between various traits. 

Added 1300 new words of voiced dialogue. 

Added New Story Cutscenes.

Added More Weapons and Armor items. They can be tested in the battle arena!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
- Added 5 new missions.
- 2000 words of new voiced dialogue. 
- Added New Character Dialogue for Ladro, Brady, Vexen, and Brady.
- Added 25 new items. 
- Added A battle testing mode ( Look For Julian In The Slums ).
- Added  Four new original songs.
- Added New abilities and battle animations

notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.content: This includes a change to 1080p resolution. Additionally, you will find a few new NPC's on 66th Street. One is The Trivia Man! He will give you a prize if you answer his question correctly! Also there is a battle tester NPC. There you will find a few vendors and party members to test out armor and weapons. I need to be testing out the balance of everything so let me know!
